           Golden Courgette - 2x Plug Plants - Prolific Producer
          







           Golden Courgette - A prolific variety that produces abundant golden yellow, cylindrical fruits on compact to medium-sized bushes. Best harvested when 4-8 inches long for optimal tenderness and flavor. These zucchini offer a milder, sweeter taste compared to green varieties, with pale white flesh that maintains its vibrant yellow color when cooked. An excellent choice for adding visual appeal and subtle flavor variation to summer dishes.
